claims: Cori Close is the head coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
Cori Close has held the position of head coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team since April 21, 2011.
Cori Close led the 2025-26 Bruins to their first NCAA National Championship.
UCLA had a 34-3 record in the 2025-26 season.
UCLA won the Big Ten Championship in the 2025-26 season.
The 2025-26 season was the UCLA Women's Basketball program's first NCAA title.
Cori Close swept national Coach of the Year awards (AP, Naismith, USBWA, WBCA) in the 2024-25 season.
Cori Close has surpassed 300 career wins.
Cori Close was an assistant coach at Florida State prior to UCLA.
Cori Close was an assistant coach at UC Santa Barbara prior to UCLA.
Cori Close signed a contract extension in 2023.
Cori Close's contract extension keeps her with the Bruins through the 2027-2028 season.
Tony Newnan is Associate Head Coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
Tasha Brown is an assistant coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
Soh Matsuura is an assistant coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team
